title: When to Postpone Massage
summary: A brief list of situations where home massage should be postponed.
goal: Help recognize basic stop signs before massage begins.
startingPosition: Before massage, assess general wellbeing and the intended area.
instructions: Do not begin during fever or significant acute illness.
Do not massage a recent injury, active inflammation, or damaged skin.
Do not massage an area with unexplained marked swelling, redness, or heat.
New severe pain, numbness, weakness, or dizziness should be assessed first.
direction: This is a safety check rather than a movement technique.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: when to postpone massage, without text labels.
